title: Credit Calculation Note — The Residential Natural Gas Supply Sign-Up Credit Amount
content:
1. **Amount.** The Residential Natural Gas Supply sign-up credit is the plan's sign-up credit amount — the one-time sign-up bill credit of the plan the agreement was enrolled on — posted once as a negative sign-up credit.
2. **Currency and rounding.** The credit owed is stated in US dollars and rounded half up to the cent.

### Input and its record

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Plan amount | the plan's one-time sign-up bill credit, by the plan named on the agreement record |

### Worked figure (hypothetical plan amount)

A plan whose sign-up credit amount is 60.00: the credit owed is 60.00, posted as a sign-up credit line of minus 60.00.
